title: Arrays, materialization, rendering and selectability
objective: Implement the bounded ARRAY capability owned by the CAD parity roadmap: deterministic array semantics, materialized members, rendering and selectability, canonical identities, undo/redo and Web/Electron parity, without changing Construction Graph authority or frozen Architecture v1.1 boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Rectangular, polar and path-style array workflows required by the benchmark are explicitly specified and unsupported variants fail typed rather than fabricating geometry.
Array members are canonical materialized entities with deterministic stable identities and deterministic ordering; rendering and selection expose the same canonical members.
Array creation is one atomic canonical revision and integrates with the existing undo/redo model without phantom members or stale selection.
Editing or deleting source/member geometry follows an explicit, deterministic policy and never creates hidden canonical duplicates.
Web and Electron execute the same engine-free semantic command path and converge on equivalent affected serialized state.
G3/G5/G6/G7 browser workflows exercise array creation, visibility and selection through the real UI, including negative/unsupported cases.
COMPAT-CAD-005, COMPAT-CAD-006 and COMPAT-CAD-007 verified behavior remains regression-green for selection, transforms, command prompts, canonical revisions and no-mutation guarantees.
Architecture v1.1, Construction Graph authority and engine/adapter boundaries remain unchanged unless an approved ACR is explicitly required.
non_goals: No blocks/inserts/attributes/symbol libraries; COMPAT-CAD-009 owns these.
No hatch, annotation, dimension or inspection expansion; COMPAT-CAD-010 owns these.
No durable SAVE/OPEN or multi-instance persistence; COMPAT-CAD-011/infrastructure owns persistence completion.
No DXF import/export; COMPAT-CAD-012 owns interoperability.
No layout/sheet viewport identity; COMPAT-CAD-013 owns layouts.
No architecture change without an ACR.
No benchmark score increase claim without a measured benchmark rerun.
risk_assumptions: COMPAT-CAD-007 is VERIFIED at physical merge 9232c90; it is the required semantic and selection baseline for CC008.

The existing engine-free shared geometry and canonical revision model are sufficient for materialized arrays; any native-engine dependency discovered during implementation must be isolated behind the existing adapter boundary.
Array previews remain presentation state until a single canonical commit.
Materialization must not create an application-local competing authority for shared objects.
The historical CAD-PARITY-020 governance defects have been isolated and repaired at the governance-record layer and must not be silently reintroduced by CC008.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated tests for each supported array mode, invalid inputs, no-mutation-before-commit and typed unsupported behavior.
Deterministic identity/order and byte-serialization fixtures for materialized members.
Web/Electron parity evidence over the affected semantic command stream.
Regression evidence for COMPAT-CAD-005, COMPAT-CAD-006 and COMPAT-CAD-007 behavior.
Exact-head CI evidence with any pre-existing repository failures isolated honestly.
Exact-head deployment and independent browser-agent evidence for the required array Golden workflows.
Revision-bound governance evidence sufficient for an independent Architect to verify the work item.

transitions.reason: COMPAT-CAD-007 is now VERIFIED at physical merge 9232c90. The dependency-ordered ARRAY scope is frozen, bounded and ready for assignment under Architecture v1.1.
